name: Media (image / video / camera)
doc: The image, video or camera picked on this host (input picker: image / video, camera), fitted to the screen, graded and pulsed on the beat; also its luma (mask) and luma edges (field: the gradient, for displacement). Several picked files cycle on the bar or phrase. Per host and not hashed; with nothing picked it shows a soft procedural fallback, so a scene never breaks.

luma.doc: perceptual luma 0..1 of out (height maps, keys)

edges.doc: screen-space luma gradient (Sobel), about 1 at a hard edge

fit.doc: cover crops to fill, contain shows it all with black bars

mirror.doc: flip left-right (the camera is already mirrored; this flips it back)

beat_zoom.doc: zoom in on the beat and onsets

pulse.doc: brightness pulse on the beat and onsets

drift.doc: slow pan and zoom (Ken Burns), so a still image lives

cycle.doc: several picked items: step to the next one

edge_width.doc: edges: Sobel step in screen pixels (wider = softer field)

changelog.note: first version: images, video, camera as input
